description: This Java class 'UnitsComboBoxEditor' provides a custom cell editor for JTable components that allows users to select a 'convertor' from a combo box within a table cell. It manages the display and selection of 'EcuDataConvertor' objects associated with 'LoggerData' in an ECU tuning/logging application.

classes.name: UnitsComboBoxEditor
classes.description: A custom table cell editor for selecting 'EcuDataConvertor' objects within a JTable, using a JComboBox. Implements necessary interfaces to integrate with Swing table editing components.

methods.name: getCellEditorValue
methods.description: Returns the currently selected convertor from the 'currentEcuData' object.

methods.name: getTableCellEditorComponent
methods.description: Initializes and returns a JComboBox populated with available convertors, setting its selected item to the current convertor of 'LoggerData'.

methods.name: actionPerformed
methods.description: Handles actions on the combo box, updating the 'LoggerData' with the selected convertor when an edit command is triggered.
